label: Quarter Canvas
description: Quarter canvas places a small canvas chest piece only at the very upper chest — roughly the top quarter of the front panel — providing a floating lapel with natural roll while the remainder of the jacket body is stabilised with a light fuse. It delivers the most important single benefit of canvassed construction at minimum cost, and sits above a true fused jacket in quality and feel, though without the chest-shaping properties that a full half-canvas provides. Quarter canvas is common in well-made prêt-à-porter garments positioned above entry-level fused construction.
